title: RTS camera: nametag flicker
intro: Near your pawns so their nametags show.

steps.text: Open the menu (Insert), pick the RTS preset, close the menu. The Dev HUD's CameraDistance line should say 'pitch 32 native'. Press End
Walk around, turn the camera, zoom. Nametags steady? Does the tilt look like before (not spinning, not drifting down)? Press End
Pick your usual preset again. Press End

probes.cd: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, "dev_status/CameraDistance.json"); return ok and d and d.info
